title: ONAA Protocol v0.1 Agent Card extension params (DRAFT ONAA profile, not an official A2A schema)
description: Value of `params` in the standard A2A 1.0 AgentExtension object (spec section 4.4.4) whose `uri` is `urn:onaa:a2a-ext:commerce:v0`, inside `capabilities.extensions[]`. ONAA adds NO top-level Agent Card fields. All values are self-declared claims of the agent operator and are untrusted until verified. See specs/onaa-protocol-v0.1.md section 5.

spec_versions.description: Envelope spec_version values the agent accepts, highest first. v0.1 agents MUST include "0.2.0".

roles.description: Same tokens as the registry API Role values (apps/api). hosting_provider/adapter_gateway are registry roles without ONAA message duties.

message_types.description: Envelope types this agent ACCEPTS as inbound requests.

service_modes.description: v0.1: only mock and/or sandbox. Required when roles contains service_provider.

jwks_uri.description: https URL of the agent's RFC 7517 JWK Set. MUST be same-origin with the Agent Card URL. RECOMMENDED path /.well-known/onaa/jwks.json.

revoked_kids.description: Key ids the operator has revoked (compromise). Verifiers MUST reject signatures by these kids.

regions.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or GLOBAL (same tokens as the registry API).

registry_record_ids.description: Optional back-pointers to ONAA registry record ids. A claim only; verifiers check the registry record's agent_card_url points back to this card.

attestation_urls.description: Optional status URLs of ONAA attestations about this agent. A claim only; relying parties verify the signed attestation.

conformance.description: Optional inputs for the live conformance suite.

rfq.description: An RFQ body (items + currency) that the seller guarantees to answer with a QUOTE during conformance runs. Must be sample/test data.

trade_trigger.description: CONFORMANCE ONLY (buyers, OPTIONAL, section 12.1). Present only while the operator has explicitly enabled the conformance trade trigger. Absent means disabled.

harness_counterparty.description: CONFORMANCE ONLY (section 12.1). Declared by harness-controlled test counterparties, never by production agents.
